title: Death of John Norseen

tellings.quote: Norine died while on business for Concurrent Technologies on September 27th, 2007.

plain: A researcher named John Norseen is said to have died on September 27, 2007, while travelling on business for Concurrent Technologies, the company he worked for. Michels gives the date himself, without naming a source, in an episode about American scientists who have died or gone missing. He raises it as one case in that pattern.
